description: The user's own open candidacies: missions they offered to take and resources they offered to bring. For each, the terms on the table (after any counter-proposal), who in the rikma has signed and who has not yet, and the deadline - when it passes with no counter, silence approves the candidacy. Read-only. To withdraw one, use withdrawCandidacyTool with its applicationId and kind (after the user says yes); to discuss or counter, give the user `url` if they are a member of that rikma, or `openingUrl` (the public page of the opening, open to anyone) if not. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#listMyApplicationsTool
name: listMyApplicationsTool
